note: The paper previously claimed ~232,000 traces / ~1.5e6 per-step comparisons across twelve scenarios. That claim was not backed by any archived manifest, log, or intermediate artifact anywhere in the repository. This pipeline (matcher_tla/run_experiments.sh + scenarios/gen_seeded.py) is architecturally one TLC target-search run per (scenario, structural-target) pair -- it cannot reach anywhere near 232,000 traces by construction (13 scenarios x 9 target types = 117 runs at most). No other trace-generation pipeline was found in the repository. The 232k/1.5M numbers have been removed from the paper and replaced with these freshly reproduced, real, smaller numbers.

phase_A_safety_only.note: The 9 timeouts are an artifact of this run's reduced --timeout 120 (vs. the script's 1800s default), chosen for a fast turnaround; they are not invariant violations (VIOLATED=0 confirms no safety-invariant failures were found in the states explored before timeout). Re-running with the default 1800s timeout would very likely clear these but was not done in this pass.
